findings.title: Inbound token `authorization_bearer` is read without linked validation evidence
findings.description: Inbound bearer/API-key evidence was detected, but no local validation, lookup, or compare evidence was linked for the same token artifact.
findings.suggested_fix: Add or identify source-bound validation evidence before the token is trusted.
findings.reviewer_question: Where is this inbound token checked before it authorizes access?

findings.title: JWT `access_jwt` has logout evidence without linked denylist evidence
findings.description: A logout handler and access-JWT lifecycle evidence were detected in linked source context, but no source-bound denylist, blocklist, or token revocation-store insertion evidence was linked for the same logout flow.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert the JWT identifier into a denylist/blocklist or revoke-store on logout, or document the intentional short-TTL stateless model for reviewer confirmation.
findings.reviewer_question: Where does logout revoke or denylist outstanding `access_jwt` tokens?

findings.title: JWT `access_jwt` is issued without linked validation evidence
findings.description: JWT issue evidence was linked into a lifecycle path, but no validation evidence was linked for the same artifact.
findings.suggested_fix: Add or identify verification evidence that validates this token before claims are trusted.
findings.reviewer_question: Where is this issued JWT validated before use?

findings.title: Refresh token `refresh_token` has logout evidence without family revocation
findings.description: Logout and refresh-token lifecycle evidence were detected in linked source context, but no source-bound user-scoped or refresh-family revocation evidence was linked for the logout flow.
findings.suggested_fix: Revoke the user's refresh-token family, delete user-scoped refresh-token records, or remove the refresh-family cache key during logout.
findings.reviewer_question: Where does logout revoke every refresh token in the `refresh_token` family or for the current user?

findings.title: JWT `unknown_jwt` verification has no not-before validation evidence
findings.description: JWT verification evidence does not show `nbf` / not-before claim enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Require or enforce `nbf` validation where issuer policy uses not-before claims.
findings.reviewer_question: Do issued tokens for this path use `nbf`, and is it enforced in production?

findings.title: Cookie `access` is cleared on logout without linked server-side revocation
findings.description: Logout evidence clears a client-side cookie, but no linked server-side session, token, or provider revocation evidence was found for the same lifecycle path.
findings.suggested_fix: Invalidate the server-side session or refresh token in addition to deleting the browser cookie.
findings.reviewer_question: Where is the server-side session or token behind `access` revoked during logout?

findings.title: Cookie `refresh_token` is cleared on logout without linked server-side revocation
findings.description: Logout evidence clears a client-side cookie, but no linked server-side session, token, or provider revocation evidence was found for the same lifecycle path.
findings.suggested_fix: Invalidate the server-side session or refresh token in addition to deleting the browser cookie.
findings.reviewer_question: Where is the server-side session or token behind `refresh_token` revoked during logout?

findings.title: Token `unknown_token` has provider-managed or dynamic handling
findings.description: Bearer/API-key behavior appears dynamic, provider-managed, config-driven, or server-to-server only, so the static evidence should be reviewed before treating lifecycle controls as deterministic.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the provider, wrapper, or server-side policy for issuance, storage, validation, scope, expiry, rotation, and revocation.
findings.reviewer_question: Which runtime configuration or provider settings govern this token lifecycle?

findings.title: Token `refresh_token` has dynamic refresh behavior without linked revocation evidence
findings.description: Refresh lifecycle evidence appears provider-managed or dynamic, and no deterministic source-bound revoke or rotation evidence was linked for the same artifact.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the provider or runtime refresh policy rotates or revokes previous refresh tokens.
findings.reviewer_question: Which provider setting or runtime path revokes previous refresh tokens for `refresh_token`?

findings.title: JWT `unknown_jwt` expiry enforcement relies on library defaults
findings.description: JWT validation appears to rely on the library default for expiration enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Make expiration enforcement explicit or document the library version and default.
findings.reviewer_question: Which JWT library version and settings determine expiration enforcement here?
